name: eval-v1
description: Initial validation matrix. Every cell (stage, network, scenario, seed) runs all of the stage's controllers on ONE prepared scenario: identical network, route file, demand seed and SUMO seed. demand_seed = seed, so seeds also vary the generated demand.

core.description: Three-controller comparison on generated grids, all scenarios (road-closure = real SUMO closingReroute).

ablation.description: Swarm module ablations (the safety gate is never disabled).

emergency.description: Ambulance priority vs the same controller without priority (3 ambulances per run).

mixed.description: Indian mixed traffic (assumed mix) on a left-hand 5x5 grid with pedestrians, and the Bengaluru OSM sample.
